acceptance: Matching revokeResourceRead replay returns the persisted original changed and aclEpoch after current resource deletion or state change.
Missing or malformed stored changed/acl_epoch fails closed with IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_INVALID.
Existing operation digest/event type conflicts, lock order, first-call resource checks, and audit transaction remain intact.
interfaces: revokeResourceRead(OperatorDatabase, RevokeResourceReadInput) -> { changed: boolean; aclEpoch: number }
verification: fresh guarded PostgreSQL RED then GREEN on isolated dedicated DBs
